title: Governed Cross-Node Delegation Protocol and Capability Fencing
author: system.atlas

intent_and_scope.problem_statement: Edge nodes require governed capability consumption from other nodes (e.g. desktop preview, safe file read, notifications) without exposing arbitrary remote shell or lateral movement vulnerabilities.
intent_and_scope.proposed_solution: Establish agentos.cross-node-delegation/v1 with strict capability fencing in Central ONE Realm Fabric. Allow whitelisted actions (desktop.open_url, desktop.screenshot, safe filesystem) while fail-closed blocking shell.exec and unapproved calls.
intent_and_scope.boundary_guarantees: Lateral shell execution between nodes is strictly rejected at the ONE Gateway with 401/PermissionError. Receipts are immutably recorded.
